name: Mofezolac

similar.name: Valdecoxib
problems: Pulled from the market in United States and 3 other countries, first in 2005 — for serious skin reactions and heart harm
Carries a boxed warning in United States

summary: Based on a small computer model rather than human tests, Mofezolac received a high risk score for the liver and a low risk score for the heart [M]. The drug itself has no listed problems, FDA details, or trial data reported here [1][2]. However, a similar drug called Valdecoxib carries a boxed warning in the United States and was pulled from the market there and in three other countries starting in 2005 due to heart harm and severe skin reactions [3].
